description: Tripwire lines between two hooks (z=1, 3, 5, 9): an armor stand in the wire powers both hooks until the 10-tick recheck after it is gone; a removed wire pulses the hooks and detaches them; a disarmed wire is ignored (stepping on it detaches the line for 10 ticks; removing it gives no pulse); a piston popping a wire pulses them; hooks put by /setblock after the wire stay unattached until the wire is hit, and when one hook breaks the wire stays attached; sand falling through a wire (z=11) triggers it.
